component.name: Birdtray Lite
component.summary: System tray new mail notification for Thunderbird

description.p: Birdtray Lite shows the unread email count from Thunderbird in the system tray, and can hide and show the Thunderbird window. It reads Thunderbird's mail index files directly, so no extension is needed. It is a fork of Birdtray by George Yunaev.
